title: Select a fixed example list with a per-label reserve
description:
## Purpose

Add a `FixedExampleList` context policy so the default product shows the same balanced example list for every item.

## Scope

- New `ContextPolicy` `fixed-example-list`, version `1`: ordered primary IDs (`per_label`, default 4) plus **one reserve per label**, each with label and input hash; `display_order`; `presentation_label_order`; a fingerprint over all of it.
- **Reserve rule:** if the target is in the list (by ID or normalized text), substitute that label's reserve. Keeps the list balanced and gives labeled items honest leave-one-out answers (today `_validated_candidate_pools` would otherwise fail).
- The shared firewall (`validate_selected_context`) still validates the result.
- `artifacts._policy_from_metadata` allowlists the new policy. Existing policies, versions and fingerprints are unchanged.
- Offline, no new dependency. Phase 1, design build step 1.

## Definition of done

Specs first, beside `context.py` / `artifacts.py`: firewall holds, reserve swap, balance preserved, fingerprint stable and sensitive to membership/order, artifact round trip. `make test` green. Cost: $0.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Select a fixed example list with a per-label reserve
  Scenario: A target that is in the list gets its label's reserve
    Given a fixed example list with 4 examples and 1 reserve per label
    When the target is one of the listed examples
    Then the context uses that label's reserve, stays balanced, and never contains the target
  Scenario: The list survives an artifact round trip
    Given a saved artifact for a fixed example list
    When it is reloaded with the example texts
    Then the policy fingerprint and the selected context are identical
```

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §1.2 (`fewshot` block, reserve rule), §1.3, §6 step 1, Appendix A (`context.py`).

Note: display order and presentation label order stay in the plan/artifact, not in the list fingerprint. make test green (226).
